You can find vampires in New Orleans, Louisiana, where Anne Rice's gothic novels and the city's history have made vampire legends a major part of its culture and tours. Real vampires don't exist, so you'd only meet them in fiction, lore, and themed attractions. Forks, Washington is the other plausible answer because it's the setting of the *Twilight* Cullens, so I'm not certain which one the team means.
